question: If an X-m long train running at a speed of 63 m/s crosses a railway platform in 28 sec, find the value of X, if the length of the railway platform is 213 m.3704
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance = speed × time = 63 × 28 = 1764 m

Total distance = train length + platform length

⇒ X + 213 = 1764

⇒ X = 1764 − 213 = 1551 m

**∴ Answer = 1551 m**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed = 63 m/sec, Time = 28 sec, Platform length = 213 m

**Formula used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total distance covered = 63 × 28 = 1764 m

⇒ Total distance = Train length + Platform length

⇒ 1764 = X + 213

⇒ X = 1764 − 213

⇒ X = 1551 m

**∴ The correct answer is 1551 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Train Crossing Platform

Distance = Train length + Platform length

Speed Formula

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

Unit Check

Keep units consistent (m, sec)

Quick Tip

Always add lengths when crossing objects
